categories.name: daos.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: daos.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens that have active hedge funds on daos.fun.

categories.name: Privacy Browser
categories.content: A privacy browser is a browser built or hardened to block trackers, ads, fingerprinting, and data leaks by default, keeping your activity more private from websites and advertisers.

categories.name: Legal
categories.content: Legal industry handles subjective disputes that cannot be solved by smart contracts.

categories.name: Zodiac-Themed
categories.content: Meme coins related to zodiac signs.

categories.name: Pools Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through Pools (https://pools.trade/), Uniswap's first-party token issuance platform.

categories.name: Market-Making Solution
categories.content: A Market-Making Solution refers to a service that enhances liquidity in markets by consistently offering buy and sell orders.

categories.name: Reddit Points
categories.content: Reddit Community Points are blockchain tokens that are owned and controlled by a specific Reddit community. With these point tokens, a community member can own a piece of their favorite subreddit. The points can be earned through contributions in the community such as post creation, comments, and content moderations.

categories.name: Wormhole Assets
categories.content: The Wormhole project is a bidirectional, decentralized SPL token bridge between Solana and EVM chains.

categories.name: Camelot Launchpad
categories.content: Camelot Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.

categories.name: America.fun Launchpad
categories.content: America.fun is the first USD1-native launchpad on Solana, designed to build a secure, 'American Dream' themed ecosystem for fair-launch tokens.

categories.name: Ondo Intelligent Portfolios
categories.content: Single-token portfolio products issued by Ondo Finance that bundle multiple tokenized assets into one on-chain instrument. Each portfolio packages a themed basket that is drawn from Ondo's tokenized equities, ETFs, and in some cases crypto assets.

categories.name: Decentralized Lottery
categories.content: A decentralized lottery is a blockchain-based lottery system that conducts draws through smart contracts.

categories.name: ERC 404
categories.content: ERC-404 is an experimental token standard that aims to bridge fungible tokens and NFTs to enable liquidity and fractionalization.

categories.name: Binance Wallet IDO
categories.content: Tokens and coins launched on Binance Wallet IDO.

categories.name: Sticker-Themed Coins
categories.content: Meme coins inspired by Telegram Sticker Packs

categories.name: Unitas Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokens issued by Unitas Labs (unitas.so), a crypto-native yield protocol governed by the Unipay DAO.

categories.name: TimeFi
categories.content: TimeFi is a blockchain-based approach to treating time as a monetizable asset through tokenized productivity, verifiable commitments, and AI-driven incentives.

categories.name: Tokenized Private Credit
categories.content: Tokenized private credit refers to the digital representation of economic claims on non-publicly traded debt instruments, such as direct loans to businesses or consumers.

categories.name: Tokenized Money Market Fund (MMFs)
categories.content: Tokens that represent shares or units (1:1) of a regulated money market fund, issued or recorded on-chain by a regulated entity. The token is yield-bearing, passing through the fund's NAV and returns via accumulating or distributing share classes.
